caption: The video showcases a close-up 3D render of faceted gemstones set against a bright, near-white background. A deep-blue faceted stone, a colorless diamond, and a round pink-red gem form the sharp central cluster, while larger blurred gems frame them. As the viewpoint drifts, the blue stone's apparent tilt changes, making its crown look more upright and its facet pattern shift. The pink gem also changes angle slightly, moving a little away from the white stone while retaining its round silhouette. Star-shaped glints flicker across the stones, appearing more often on the pink gem early and on the blue gem later. The background shapes slide past the cluster, with the red mass at lower left growing and shifting outward while the cluster shifts orientation in view.
